description: This file defines the EndpointCollectionResult class, which extends AbstractEndpointResult and provides normalization functionality for a collection of data, handling serialization of multiple models in an API context within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: EndpointCollectionResult
classes.description: A class that extends AbstractEndpointResult, providing normalization methods for collections of models, with logic to handle different serialization scenarios within the API.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Returns a normalized array of data. Checks if the model class implements CollectionNormalizable; if so, serializes a single object; otherwise, serializes an array of objects.
